home.title: Good food, made for
home.description: Find nourishing recipes with honest ingredients, useful nutrition, and servings that scale to your table.
recipe.allergenDisclaimer: Allergen labels are based on listed ingredients and are not a guarantee for allergy safety.
recipe.profileWarning: This recipe matches your saved allergy profile.
recipe.profileDisclaimer: Do not rely on this label alone to determine whether a food is safe for you.
nutrition.estimates: Approximate food-composition estimates. Percent Daily Values use standard adult references, not individualized targets. Values vary with ingredients and preparation; this information is not medical advice.
nutrition.unavailable: Nutrition details are not available for this recipe.
recipe.swapDisclaimer: Recipe directions and nutrition still reflect the original ingredient; adjust preparation as needed.
recipe.defaultDescription: A balanced, nourishing recipe that brings flavor and simplicity together.
zero.title: Zero-waste recipe finder
zero.description: Add ingredients you want to use up. Recipes are ranked by how many of those ingredients they include.
zero.matchNote: A match means the recipe lists a similar ingredient. Check freshness, quantity, and recipe details before cooking.
zero.emptyTitle: Add a few ingredients to get started.
zero.emptyNote: The list is saved in this browser and used only to rank recipe matches.
zero.noMatches: No recipes match those ingredients yet.
zero.tryBroader: Try a broader ingredient name or update your pantry list.
zero.unknown: Not recognized as a known ingredient; it is still included in matching.
zero.ambiguous: This name may refer to more than one ingredient. Try a more specific name.
zero.corianderExample: Coriander leaves, coriander seeds, and coriander powder are matched separately.
browse.title: Browse recipes
browse.allergyNote: Selected allergens are saved in this browser and automatically excluded from results. Recipe tags may be incomplete and cannot guarantee allergy safety or prevent cross-contact.
browse.tryAgain: Try a different search or clear your filters.
